title: Tidebreaker: Coral Run
summary: GLM-5.3 Flash leads, with GLM-5.3 subagents.
description: A tropical combat-speedboat route with gate rings, mines, boats, drones, a sea cave and a waterfall jump. Built in OMP from the shared combat-speedboat brief, with Flash leading and GLM-5.3 as subagents. Both models used max reasoning.
